raw_segments.text: I blew the candle out and left the cabin.
The pilgrims were dining in the mess room, and I took my place opposite the manager,
who lifted his eyes to give me a questioning glance, which I successfully ignored.
He leaned back, serene, with that peculiar smile of his sealing the unexpressed depths
A continuous shower of small flies streamed upon the lamp, upon the cloth, upon our hands
